name: Dinks Only
effect: All shots this point must be dinks. Anything harder = lose the point.

name: No Volleys
effect: You must let every ball bounce before hitting. No volleys allowed.

name: Backhand Only
effect: Every shot this point must be a backhand.

name: Lobs Welcome
effect: You may ONLY win the point with a lob winner.

name: Drop Shot Mandate
effect: Your return of serve must be a drop into the kitchen.

name: No Smashes
effect: Overhead smashes are banned this point. Anything above the head must be redirected soft.

name: Slice City
effect: Every shot must have visible underspin. Flat shots = fault.

name: Forehand Famine
effect: You may not use your forehand this point.

name: One Bounce Rule
effect: Every ball must bounce twice on your side before you return it.

name: Kitchen Confined
effect: You must hit this entire point standing inside the kitchen.

name: Topspin Tax
effect: Any shot without topspin loses you the point. Brush up!

name: Two-Hand Mandatory
effect: All shots must be hit with two hands on the paddle.

name: No Cross-Court
effect: Every shot must go down-the-line. Cross-court = fault.

name: Half Court
effect: Your opponent must only hit to half the court. You pick which half.

name: Reset Required
effect: Before you can win the point, your team must hit one full reset dink.

name: No Power
effect: Any shot hit harder than a 'firm tap' is a fault. Touch shots only.

name: Mid-Court Only
effect: Every shot must land in the transition zone (between kitchen line and baseline halfway).

name: Serve Soft
effect: Server must hit an underhand lob serve. No power serves.

name: Three-Touch Rule
effect: Your team must touch the ball at least 3 times before winning (if doubles).

name: Spinless
effect: All shots must be hit flat. Any visible spin = lose the point.

name: Non-Dominant Hand
effect: Switch paddle hands. You're a lefty now (or righty).

name: One Foot Only
effect: You must keep one foot off the ground the entire point.

name: Hop to It
effect: You can only move by hopping on both feet, no walking or running.

name: Side Shuffle
effect: You may not face forward — only side-shuffle this point.

name: Eyes on Partner
effect: You must look at your partner, not the ball, between every shot. (Doubles)

name: Squat Stance
effect: You must stay in a low squat the entire point.

name: No Wrist
effect: You must keep your wrist locked. No wrist snap on any shot.

name: Behind the Back
effect: First shot of the point must be hit behind your back.

name: Tippy Toes
effect: You must stay on your toes — no heels down — entire point.

name: Mirror Partner
effect: You must mirror your partner's exact position on the court. (Doubles)

name: Pivot Only
effect: You may not take steps. Only pivot on one foot.

name: Underhand Everything
effect: Every shot must be hit below your waist.

name: Above the Head
effect: Every shot must be contacted above your shoulders.

name: Slow Motion
effect: All your movement must be in visible slow motion this point.

name: Backward Serve
effect: You must serve facing backward, looking over your shoulder.

name: No Talking
effect: Doubles teammates may not speak this point. No 'mine,' no calls.

name: Sing It
effect: You must hum or sing continuously the whole point.

name: High Five Required
effect: Doubles partners must high-five between every shot they hit.

name: Dance Move
effect: Do a dance move after every shot you hit, before resetting.

name: No Pivot Foot
effect: Your serve must be hit while both feet are off the ground.

name: Partner Swap
effect: Swap partners with the other team for the rest of the game.

name: Side Switch
effect: Switch ends of the court immediately, mid-game.

name: Paddle Swap
effect: Trade paddles with an opponent for the next 3 points.

name: Serve Steal
effect: Steal the serve from the opposing team. Your team serves now.

name: Score Steal
effect: Take 1 point from your opponent's score and add it to yours.

name: Score Reset
effect: Both teams reset to the score 2 points ago.

name: Reverse Roles
effect: Doubles partners swap positions (deuce/ad sides) for 3 points.

name: Solo Mode
effect: One team plays with only 1 player against the doubles team for this point.

name: Wild Serve
effect: Anyone on either team can serve the next point. Pick wisely.

name: Mulligan
effect: Hold this card. Use it any time to replay one point.

name: Steal a Card
effect: Pull a card from an opponent's hand (if you've collected cards).

name: Trade Cards
effect: Swap one of your saved cards with an opponent's. Blind trade.

name: Free Pass
effect: Hold this card. You may skip drawing one card later.

name: Double Up
effect: Next point counts for 2 points instead of 1.

name: Triple Threat
effect: Next point counts for 3. Lose it and lose 3.

name: Swap Drawn Card
effect: Don't like your card? Swap it with the top of the deck blind.

name: Force Draw
effect: Make an opponent draw a card right now.

name: Skip Their Turn
effect: Skip the opposing team's next serve. Your team serves twice.

name: Reroll
effect: Discard this and the next card, then draw fresh.

name: Court Rotation
effect: All four players rotate one position clockwise around the court.

name: Lose the Serve
effect: Your team loses the serve immediately.

name: Give Up a Point
effect: Opponent gets a free point.

name: Sit Out a Point
effect: Skip the next point. Your partner plays solo. (Doubles)

name: Confession Time
effect: Tell the table one embarrassing pickleball memory before serving again.

name: Push-Ups
effect: 5 push-ups before your next serve.

name: Sing Your Apology
effect: Sing 'I'm sorry' to your partner before the next point.

name: Wrong-Handed Serve
effect: Your next serve must be hit with your non-dominant hand.

name: Lose Both Serves
effect: Skip your team's entire next service turn.

name: No Calls
effect: You may not call 'mine' or 'yours' for 3 points. (Doubles)

name: Eyes Closed Serve
effect: Your next serve must be hit with eyes shut.

name: Trash Talk Yourself
effect: Insult your own play out loud before the next point.

name: Drink Up
effect: Sip your water before every shot this point. (Add a beverage of choice.)

name: Score Tax
effect: Lose 1 point off your team's current score.

name: Compliment Opponents
effect: Compliment each opposing player before serving.

name: Granny Serve Only
effect: Underhand granny serve for the rest of the game.

name: Apologize for Every Mistake
effect: Loudly apologize for every shot you miss for 3 points.

name: Pickle Picker
effect: If the score becomes 0-7-2 ('pickled'), the team that drew this card forfeits the game.

name: Lose Your Partner
effect: Your partner sits the next point. You play solo. (Doubles)

name: Foot Fault Yourself
effect: First serve of the next game must be a deliberate foot fault.

name: Wear It
effect: Wear something silly (sunglasses, hat, towel-cape) until you win 2 points.

name: Free Point
effect: Your team gets a free point. Don't even play.

name: Double Serve
effect: Your next serve, if missed, gets a second try.

name: Two Bounce Bonus
effect: Your team can let the ball bounce twice on your side this point.

name: Reset Your Score
effect: Bring your team's score back up to match opponents (or to 0 if you were ahead — your choice).

name: Pick the Court Side
effect: Choose which side you want to play from for the next 3 points.

name: Big Kitchen
effect: Your team's kitchen line is moved 1 foot back for the point. More volley space.

name: Small Kitchen for Them
effect: Opponents' kitchen line is moved 1 foot forward. Tighter for them.

name: Skip Their Serve
effect: Opposing team loses their next serve.

name: Hold for Later
effect: Hold this card. Play any time to claim 1 point.

name: Choose Their Restriction
effect: Pick any Shot Restriction card from the discard pile and force opponents to play under it.

name: Game Win Insurance
effect: If you lose this game, you may demand a rematch immediately.

name: First Serve Choice
effect: You choose who serves first in the next game.

name: Free Coaching
effect: Get one 30-second sideline tip from a non-playing friend.

name: Power Smash
effect: You get one mandatory smash this point — opponents must let it through.

name: Double Down
effect: If you win the next point, it counts as 2.

name: Free Card Draw
effect: Draw another card right now.

name: Save the Score
effect: If you lose the next 3 points, your score doesn't drop.

name: Steal a Drink
effect: Take a sip of any opponent's drink. (Hydration heist.)

name: Pick Your Side
effect: Choose who returns serve next point. (Doubles)

name: Hot Streak
effect: Win the next 2 points in a row and the game ends instantly in your favor.

name: Group Selfie
effect: Stop play. All four players take a selfie at the net. Post it.

name: Compliment Chain
effect: Each player must compliment the player to their left before the next serve.

name: Trash Talk Turn
effect: Each player must deliver one G-rated piece of trash talk to opponents.

name: Victory Pose
effect: Whoever wins this point must hold a victory pose for 10 seconds.

name: Loser's Dance
effect: Whoever loses this point must do a 5-second dance.

name: Name Your Shot
effect: Before every shot this point, shout the name of the shot you're hitting.

name: Cheer Squad
effect: Whoever is sitting out (waiting next game) must cheer LOUDLY for one team.

name: Celebrity Impression
effect: Play the next point in the voice of a celebrity of your choice.

name: Pun Required
effect: Make a pickleball pun before the next serve. Bad ones count.

name: Confession
effect: Share one true pickleball pet peeve out loud.

name: Story Time
effect: Tell a 30-second story about your worst sports moment.

name: Cheers Card
effect: Everyone clinks water bottles before the next point.

name: Nickname Time
effect: Each player gets a random nickname (assigned by opponents) for the rest of the game.

name: Hot Take
effect: Each player must share a pickleball hot take before continuing.

name: MVP Vote
effect: All players vote on the current MVP of the match. Winner gets to choose next serve side.

name: Snack Break
effect: 30-second snack/drink pause. Everyone shares something.

name: Group Hug
effect: All four players group-hug at the net. Then play continues.

name: Trash Talk Ban
effect: No trash talk allowed for the next 5 points. Penalty: lose point.

name: Compliment Loser
effect: After this point, the winners must say something nice about the losers' game.

name: Hashtag It
effect: Create a hashtag for today's match. Use it for the rest of the day.

name: Coach's Choice
effect: Pick a shot type. Anytime you successfully execute it this game, you score a bonus point.

name: ATP Time
effect: Around-the-post winners count for 3 points this game.

name: Erne Bounty
effect: First player to hit a successful Erne wins the next 2 points automatically.

name: Soft Game
effect: Next 3 points must all be third-shot drops. No driving allowed.

name: Drill Down
effect: Play the next point as a dinking-only rally. First to drive loses the point.

name: Communicate
effect: Doubles teams must call 'mine'/'yours' on every shot for 3 points or lose the point.

name: Stack Up
effect: Switch to a stacked formation this game. Mix it up.

name: Lefty Side
effect: Pretend the left side player is a lefty (paddle on the left for the team). Rotate accordingly.

name: Reset Hero
effect: Each successful reset (returning a hard ball softly into the kitchen) earns a bonus point.

name: Body Bag Bounty
effect: If anyone wins a point with a body shot (hits opponent), it's worth 2.

name: Lob Defender
effect: Every successful lob defense (smash or reset on a lob) earns 1 extra point.

name: Third Shot Drop Only
effect: All serves the next 3 points must be followed by a third-shot drop. No drives.

name: Speed Up Bonus
effect: Win a point with a speed-up off a dink and earn 2 points instead of 1.

name: Defensive Drill
effect: Block-and-reset wins only — no offensive winners this point.

name: Server's Choice
effect: Server picks the rule for this point. (Anything reasonable.)

name: Coach's Eye
effect: Best technique winner. Players vote at end of point — winner takes 1 point.

name: No Bangers
effect: If anyone hits a 'banger' (full-power drive without setup), they lose the point.

name: Patience Pays
effect: Rallies under 6 shots count for half a point. 6+ shots count for 2.

name: Court Geometry
effect: Each shot must land in a different quadrant than the previous one.

name: Tournament Mode
effect: Play the next point as if it's match point. Sudden death intensity.

name: Talk Like a Pirate
effect: All speech this point must be in pirate voice. Arrr.

name: British Accent
effect: Play and speak with a British accent the entire point.

name: Animal Sounds
effect: Replace all words with animal noises for 1 full point.

name: Nickname Roulette
effect: Each player picks a new nickname. Address each other only by nicknames for the rest of the game.

name: Slow-Mo Mode
effect: Play the next point in obvious slow motion — both teams.

name: Sportscaster
effect: One non-playing person must commentate live the entire next point.

name: Theme Music
effect: Hum your own theme song before every shot you hit.

name: Court Hopscotch
effect: You must hop on one foot between every shot you hit.

name: Whisper Match
effect: All communication must be in a whisper for 3 points.

name: Shout Mode
effect: All communication must be SHOUTED for 3 points.

name: Robot Mode
effect: Move and speak like a robot the entire next point.

name: Backwards Day
effect: Score this point in reverse — winner of the point LOSES the point. Sneakily try to lose.

name: Compliment Every Shot
effect: Compliment your opponent's every shot, even bad ones, all point.

name: Trick Shot Mandate
effect: Win the point with a between-the-legs, behind-the-back, or no-look shot or it doesn't count.

name: Yell the Score
effect: Yell the score, very loudly, before every serve for 3 points.

name: Court Limbo
effect: Whoever wins the point must limbo under their own paddle held by opponents.

name: Funny Walk
effect: All movement must be a Monty Python silly walk this point.

name: Pickle Roll Call
effect: Yell 'PICKLE!' after every successful shot you hit, all point.

name: Bad Coach Mode
effect: Each player must shout terrible advice to opponents during the point.

name: Mime Mode
effect: No speech allowed — only gestures and mime — for the next 3 points.

name: Shrunken Court
effect: The kitchen extends to the baseline this point — entire opponent half is no-volley zone.

name: Giant Kitchen
effect: Both kitchens double in size. Volleying is rare.

name: Sideline Tax
effect: Any ball landing within 6 inches of a sideline wins automatically.

name: Centerline Hot Zone
effect: Any ball landing on the centerline counts as 2 points.

name: Treasure Spot
effect: Place a paddle cover or towel on a court spot. First to land 3 shots on it wins next point.

name: Wind Pretend
effect: Pretend there's a strong wind blowing from one direction. Adjust every shot accordingly.

name: Phantom Player
effect: Play this point as if there's an invisible 5th player at the net. Don't hit 'them.'

name: Bouncing Bonus
effect: Any ball that bounces in the kitchen counts double if you win the point.

name: Net Cord Wins
effect: Any net-cord shot that goes over and lands in = automatic point.

name: Wall Bounce
effect: If your shot hits the back fence/wall and stays in play, it's a free point. (Outdoor only.)

name: Boundary Bonus
effect: If you hit the line, you get an extra point.

name: No Right Side
effect: Half the court is out of bounds. Pick a half — the right side is dead.

name: Corner Quest
effect: First team to land shots in all four corners (any order) wins the next point.

name: Mirror Court
effect: Cross-court shots are illegal. Down-the-line only.

name: Diagonal Only
effect: Down-the-line shots are illegal. Cross-court only.

name: Shadow Drill
effect: Whichever side has the sun in their eyes (or imaginary sun) gets +1 to their score for the next point.

name: Wet Court
effect: Pretend the court is wet. Move cautiously — no quick lateral cuts.

name: Echo Court
effect: Every spoken word must be repeated by the speaker twice. (For 3 points.)

name: Spotlight On
effect: All eyes on one player. Picked player must hit every shot for their team this point. (Doubles)

name: Cone Challenge
effect: Place water bottles or cones on the court. Hitting them = bonus point. Players try to dodge.

name: Draw Two
effect: Draw two more cards and play both effects this point.

name: Discard Pile Draw
effect: Take any card from the discard pile and play it.

name: Skip Next Draw
effect: Skip the next scheduled card draw. No effects next point.

name: Sudden Shuffle
effect: Shuffle the discard pile back into the deck immediately.

name: Pick a Card
effect: Choose which card opponents must play (pull blind from the deck, then trade).

name: Auction
effect: The next card drawn goes to whichever team wins the next point. Stakes raised.

name: Card Hand
effect: Hold any drawn card from now on. Play them strategically.

name: Trade Now
effect: Trade your card with the player to your left. No looking.

name: Reveal All
effect: Everyone shows the cards they're holding. Adjust strategy.

name: Wild Card
effect: Choose any past card effect from the discard pile and replay it.

name: Stack Effect
effect: All cards drawn this game must be played at once next point. Hope you saved a good one.

name: Card Chain
effect: Whoever wins this point also gets to play the next card drawn.

name: Time Bomb
effect: In 3 points, draw another card no matter what.

name: Force Play
effect: Force an opponent to play their next held card right now.

name: No-Card Round
effect: No cards may be drawn for the next 5 points.

name: Quick Draw
effect: Both teams draw a card. Highest-stakes card wins this point.

name: Reverse Deck
effect: Reverse the next card's effect — penalties become bonuses, restrictions hit the other team.

name: Permanent
effect: The next card drawn stays in effect for the rest of the game.

name: House Rule
effect: Players vote on a new rule that applies the rest of the game. Majority wins.

name: End Card
effect: Skip directly to game point. Whoever wins this point wins the game.
